correctness.rationale: The parity-of-adjacent-11-bits definition gives s_(2t)=(-1)^t and s_(2t+1)=(-1)^t s_t. Pairing a length-2^k window yields S_k(j)=U_(k-1)(floor(j/2)), with U_l(j)=-U_(l-1)(floor(j/2)) for l>=2. Exact slide invariance follows matching signed endpoint terms for odd shifts. Thus S_k(j)=(-1)^(k-2+q)(s_q-s_(q+1)), q=floor(j/2^(k-1)), for all j>=0,k>=3. Pairwise U1(2h),U1(2h+1) make exactly half of q zero; their nonzero signs balance over complete dyadic q blocks, giving proportions 1/4,1/2,1/4. Independently summed direct words for k=3..7 with arbitrary starts j<400 and verified histograms m=2..6. Infinite quantifiers rest on transfer proof.
